method: Current official patriarchal, synodal, diocesan, parish, monastery, clergy, and service sources were checked. Search and map results were used only for discovery. The published union follows the current Macedonian Orthodox Church structure after the 2023 integration of the former Orthodox Ohrid Archbishopric. Historical, ruined, abandoned, unfinished, unconsecrated, duplicated, archaeologically attested, or otherwise unclear bodies remain here rather than being published as current rows.

candidates.name: Former Orthodox Ohrid Archbishopric structure
candidates.status: historical structure integrated in 2023
candidates.reason: The Serbian Holy Assembly and the Macedonian synodal act document the 2023 integration of the former Orthodox Ohrid Archbishopric into the Macedonian Orthodox Church. Its former diocesan and parish structure is not duplicated as a separate current jurisdiction. The resulting current eparchies are published under the Macedonian Orthodox Church.

source_reconciliations.subject: Current Macedonian diocesan structure after the 2023 integration
source_reconciliations.decision: Current synodal sources establish eleven domestic eparchies and fifteen total eparchies. Krushevo and Demir Hisar, Deljadrovo and Ilinden, and Delchevo and Kamenica are preserved as current eparchies. The former Orthodox Ohrid Archbishopric is not duplicated as a separate current jurisdiction.

source_reconciliations.subject: Skopje church and monastery roster duplicates
source_reconciliations.decision: The identical Saint Petka in Mirkovci entry appears twice in the current church roster without a discriminator and is published once. The last four entries on the monastery page duplicate dependent chapel rows already carried by the church roster, so each is published once as a chapel rather than duplicated as a monastery.

source_reconciliations.subject: Deljadrovo assignment in the Kumanovo and Osogovo roster
source_reconciliations.decision: The older Kumanovo and Osogovo roster still carries a Deljadrovo parish, but current synodal sources establish the separate Deljadrovo and Ilinden Eparchy from 2023. The stale Deljadrovo assignment is not published under Kumanovo and Osogovo without a current reassignment source.

source_reconciliations.subject: Bregalnica monasteries
source_reconciliations.decision: The legacy eparchial monastery page is marked as under construction, but the central Macedonian active-monastery list and the current eparchial news channel directly establish twelve active monasteries. Search and map results were not used as publication evidence.

source_reconciliations.subject: Prespa and Pelagonia source gap
source_reconciliations.decision: The official eparchy site currently returns a server error on much of its structure. The current indexed Bitola cathedral page and Serbian concelebration report establish Saint Demetrius Cathedral and its four parishes. The central active-monastery list and current first-party church reporting establish eight monasteries that remain inside the present eparchy. Older material crossing the 2023 Krushevo and Demir Hisar boundary was not used to infer current assignments.

source_reconciliations.subject: Povardarie duplicate and current-status reconciliation
source_reconciliations.decision: All thirty-four linked official roster articles were reconciled. Duplicate descriptions of the same body were merged rather than counted twice. Explicit ruins, abandoned sites, unconsecrated sites, construction-only projects, archaeology, and headings without a dedication or current status remain candidates. The current active-monastery list adds the Sermenin monastery, producing 154 published rows and 41 site candidates.

official_jurisdiction_audit.result: The complete publishable union follows the current eleven-eparchy domestic structure. Official eparchy rosters and current local pages establish the published dioceses, deaneries, parishes, churches, chapels, monasteries, and other recurring worship sites. Conservative source gaps remain recorded above.

official_jurisdiction_audit.jurisdiction: Serbian Orthodox Church and former Orthodox Ohrid Archbishopric
official_jurisdiction_audit.result: The former Orthodox Ohrid Archbishopric was integrated in 2023 and is not a separate current structure. Current Serbian reports establish occasional services or memorial activity, but no separate current Serbian parish, mission, monastery, or regularly scheduled worship body in North Macedonia was found.

The 2022 synodal act receives the Church in North Macedonia into communion while defining the territorial matter for further settlement. No separate current Ecumenical Patriarchate parish, mission, monastery, or recurring worship site in North Macedonia was established by the official sources reviewed.

official_jurisdiction_audit.jurisdiction: Ukrainian Orthodox Church and Orthodox Church of Ukraine
official_jurisdiction_audit.result: The UOC's current Western European vicariate description expressly states that it does not open parishes in North Macedonia. No current OCU parish, mission, monastery, or recurring worship site in North Macedonia was found in the official structures reviewed.

No completed current Russian or ROCOR parish, mission, monastery, or recurring worship site in North Macedonia was found in the official structures reviewed. The Russian memorial church project remains a candidate because current completion and jurisdiction were not established.

official_jurisdiction_audit.jurisdiction: Bulgarian Orthodox Church, Romanian Orthodox Church, and Orthodox Church in America
official_jurisdiction_audit.result: The cited Bulgarian Western and Central European diocesan roster, Romanian external-community roster, and Orthodox Church in America parish directory do not list a parish, mission, monastery, or recurring worship site in North Macedonia. No unverified search or map discovery was promoted.
